diff: Horse x1 HP 5 / 4; Rabbit x4 HP 5 / 6
mechanism: Two Salad Bowls and one Rabbit. Permuting notifications within an already-selected Salad pair reproduces the real health split.

diff: Camel x2 HP 8 / 7; Turtle x3 HP 8 / 9
mechanism: Two Salad Bowls reach a Rabbit’s three-use cap. The same recipients can generate the recorded health if the capped notification goes to the other pet.
The two Canned Foods consumed the native Rabbit’s uses on shop pets. The real Tiger received the level-two Rabbit’s +2 HP when it ate Bread.

diff: Penguin x1 HP 7 / 6; Snail x2 HP 9 / 8; Flamingo x3 HP 9 / 8
mechanism: Ignoring Canned Food’s shop pets for Rabbit’s budget accounts for the three later +1 HP adjustments on the actual board.
The real frozen Scorpion was bare. The native constructor attached Peanut while the pet was still in the shop.

diff: Squirrel x0 HP 7 / 8; Camel x3 HP 14 / 13
mechanism: Canned Food precedes the Squirrel buy-merge and the Camel’s Cupcake. The native shop Squirrel picked up an extra HP that survived the merge; the real Camel received that HP. This matches Rabbit spending a use on shop stock.
The recorded frozen Scorpion had no perk while its native counterpart already had Peanut.

diff: Rhino x3 HP 16 / 18; Rabbit x4 HP 28 / 26
mechanism: Steak consumes one Rabbit use before Sushi. Changing which two Sushi recipients receive the remaining health bonuses accounts for the difference, with the Cat and Sushi stat buffs unchanged.

diff: Rabbit x0 HP 4 / 3; Rabbit x4 HP 11 / 12
mechanism: Two Rabbits and two Salad Bowls. Independent recipient order for each Rabbit can split the last health points as recorded. A single shared fixed order does not reproduce this split.

diff: Cat x1 HP 7 / 9; Shark x2 HP 10 / 8
mechanism: Better Apple consumes a Rabbit use before Sushi. Changing the order of the Sushi notifications accounts for the Cat/Shark health difference.
